# Quarterly Membership Database Maintenance and Export Log
Staff Member: Keiko Kowalczyk, Administrative Assistant
Date: 04/06/2026
Department: Operations and Member Services

## Batch Update Summary
| Category | Prior Count | Records Added | Records Archived | Active Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Individual Sustaining | 412 | 28 | 15 | 425 |
| Corporate Sponsor | 86 | 4 | 2 | 88 |
| Student Affiliate | 194 | 45 | 31 | 208 |
| Total Database Records | 692 | 77 | 48 | 721 |

## Routine Maintenance Actions Taken
- Executed duplicate check across email and phone fields; merged 6 duplicate profiles.
- Updated postal address changes submitted via the web portal between 01/01/2026 and 03/31/2026.
- Flagged non-renewing profiles with no activity for 24 months for archive status.
- Ran data standardization macro on all phone numbers to format as ten-digit standard strings.

## Export Instructions for Annual Renewal Mail Merge
- Target export file: Q1_2026_Active_Members.csv
- Export query criteria: Filter for Active status only and exclude Corporate Sponsor records.
- The filtered query yields 650 records ready for the mail merge print run.
- Verify that each record includes formal prefix, full mailing address, and primary contact name.
- Because Corporate Sponsor profiles are omitted from this export, be sure to suppress the company title field for the remaining corporate addresses.
